people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hanun
people.line: An Ammonite king who mistreated David's envoys.

people.name: Mesopotamia
people.line: The region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers

people.name: Zobah
people.line: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign

translations.web: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
translations.bsb: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah, and Zobah.
translations.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.
